clos.original_description: Identify and characterize multimodal AI systems and the four core problems of multimodal machine learning - representation, alignment, fusion, and translation.
clos.enriched_description: Identify and characterize multimodal AI systems and the four core problems of multimodal machine learning - representation, alignment, fusion, and translation. The scope includes Foundations of Multimodality; What multimodal AI is and isn't; The four core problems: representation, alignment, fusion, translation; and Why now: from connectors to native multimodality.

clos.original_description: Build cross-modal representations using contrastive and self-supervised methods, and evaluate them via zero-shot transfer and cross-modal retrieval.
clos.enriched_description: Build cross-modal representations using contrastive and self-supervised methods, and evaluate them via zero-shot transfer and cross-modal retrieval. The scope includes Cross-Modal Representation Learning and Contrastive learning and the InfoNCE objective.

clos.original_description: Design and implement fusion architectures (cross-attention, latent bottlenecks, connector modules) that combine heterogeneous modalities.
clos.enriched_description: Design and implement fusion architectures (cross-attention, latent bottlenecks, connector modules) that combine heterogeneous modalities. The scope includes Cross-attention as the fusion engine, Perceiver and latent bottlenecks, Q-Former and projection connectors, and Flamingo: gated cross-attention.

clos.original_description: Apply vision-language and unified multimodal architectures (LLaVA, BLIP-2, Flamingo, and unified token/diffusion-transformer families) and instruction-tune them.
clos.enriched_description: Apply vision-language and unified multimodal architectures (LLaVA, BLIP-2, Flamingo, and unified token/diffusion-transformer families) and instruction-tune them. The scope includes Flamingo: gated cross-attention; Unified-token decoder-only models (Chameleon, Emu3); and The discrete-token understanding gap.

clos.original_description: Apply multimodal techniques to non-image modalities - speech, audio, video, 3D, and embodied agents - and to cross-modal generation.
clos.enriched_description: Apply multimodal techniques to non-image modalities - speech, audio, video, 3D, and embodied agents - and to cross-modal generation. The scope includes Speech and Audio, Audio as a modality; ASR and Whisper, Audio understanding and audio-LMs, TTS and speech/music generation, Cross-Modal Generation, Text-to-audio and music generation, Video, Why video is hard: temporal structure and scale, Temporal modeling and long-video strategies, Video diffusion and text-to-video maturation, Video as a step toward world models, and Embodied agents and world models.

clos.original_description: Engineer multimodal reasoning, agent, and retrieval systems, and address the input-size and latency challenges of deploying them.
clos.enriched_description: Engineer multimodal reasoning, agent, and retrieval systems, and address the input-size and latency challenges of deploying them. The scope includes Multimodal Reasoning, Agents and Retrieval; Multimodal reasoning and thinking with images; Computer-use and GUI agents; Cross-modal retrieval and multimodal RAG; Quantization for VLMs; serving multimodal models; and Latency, cost, and model-tier selection.

clos.original_description: Evaluate multimodal systems with appropriate benchmarks and protocols, recognizing saturation and the migrating frontier, and run hallucination and grounding diagnostics.
clos.enriched_description: Evaluate multimodal systems with appropriate benchmarks and protocols, recognizing saturation and the migrating frontier, and run hallucination and grounding diagnostics. The scope includes Why evaluation is hard; the saturation story (MMMU-Pro) and Where the frontier moved: video, OCR, audio, unified eval.

clos.original_description: Analyze the safety, provenance, bias, and privacy issues specific to multimodal AI - deepfakes, watermarking, and biometric data.
clos.enriched_description: Analyze the safety, provenance, bias, and privacy issues specific to multimodal AI - deepfakes, watermarking, and biometric data. The scope includes Safety, Provenance and Frontiers / Course Wrap; The multimodal risk surface; deepfakes and synthetic media; Provenance and watermarking (C2PA); and Biometric and facial privacy; bias across modalities.
